properties.structural_trend: Lake Shore & Michigan Southern Rail Corridor (Azimuth 245°)
properties.crystallographic_alignment: Calculated via Clifford Cl(7,0) grade-1 velocity and gravity vectors intersecting the orthogonal riverbed shear plane.
properties.geological_setting: Scour-and-fill depression 45m downstream of eastern stone bridge abutment pier in Devonian Chagrin shale; estimated 4.8m depth.
properties.estimated_endowment: Estimated ,000,000 in 1876 Gold Bullion / Coin (~M+ modern value)

properties.deposit_name: Minerva Great Trail French Gold Cache
properties.structural_trend: Tuscarawas / Great Trail & Historic Rail Line (Strike 295°)
properties.crystallographic_alignment: Sits at the intersection of the 045° regional conjugate shear fracture and the Pottsville sandstone joint network.
properties.geological_setting: Collapsed sandstone cleft 210m north of historic Sandy Creek railroad bridge; estimated 2.2m depth.
properties.estimated_endowment: French military payroll of gold/silver bullion and louis d'or coins

properties.crystallographic_alignment: Forms a 70° conjugate angle with the Battle Mountain-Eureka Trend (040°), precisely matching the atomic {111} octahedral dihedral angle (70.53°).
properties.geological_setting: Deep-seated Paleozoic silty carbonate shelf sequence deformed during Roberts Mountains thrusting; Eocene magmatic hydrothermal fluid influx.
properties.estimated_endowment: >90 million oz Au (Second largest gold province on Earth)

properties.deposit_name: Battle Mountain - Eureka Trend (Cortez Hills / Pipeline / Goldrush)
properties.crystallographic_alignment: Direct conjugate counterpart to Carlin Trend across the 40°N Great Basin crustal node.
properties.geological_setting: Lower plate carbonate windows beneath Roberts Mountains allochthon; Carlin-type disseminated sediment-hosted gold.

properties.structural_trend: Black Hills Cratonic Dome / Trans-Hudson Suture (N-S strike ~005°)
properties.crystallographic_alignment: Located at the intersection of the Trans-Hudson Orogen and the Archean Wyoming Craton margin, aligning with the 44°N polyhedral lineament.
properties.geological_setting: Paleoproterozoic Homestake iron-formation; stratabound quartz-siderite-arsenopyrite replacement.
properties.estimated_endowment: 41 million oz Au mined (Historic deepest and largest underground gold mine in North America)

properties.structural_trend: Melones Fault Zone / Sierra Foothills (NNW strike ~335°)
properties.crystallographic_alignment: Major suture bivector (e1 ^ e2) between accreted Mesozoic island arcs and the North American continent; steep 70° dipping reverse fault planes.
properties.geological_setting: Orogenic mesothermal ribbon quartz veins in serpentinite and greenstone greenschist facies.
properties.estimated_endowment: >120 million oz Au (California Gold Rush epicenter)

properties.structural_trend: Colorado Mineral Belt (COMB) / Oligocene Alkaline Diatreme (SW-NE ~045°)
properties.crystallographic_alignment: Occupies an explosive volcanic diatreme breccia pipe at the junction of the 45° COMB shear corridor and ancient Proterozoic shear zones.
properties.geological_setting: Alkaline igneous volcanic complex; telluride-bearing hydrothermal epithermal vein system.

properties.structural_trend: Appalachian Gold Belt / Gold Hill Shear Zone (NE strike ~050°)
properties.crystallographic_alignment: Appalachian orogenic suture mirroring the Atlantic continental margin at an azimuthal angle of 050°.
properties.geological_setting: Neoproterozoic to Cambrian volcanic-sedimentary sequence in the Carolina terrane; pyritic disseminated gold deposit.
properties.estimated_endowment: >5 million oz Au (Largest operating gold mine on the US East Coast)

properties.structural_trend: Tintina Gold Province / Kaltag-Tintina Fault (NW strike ~300°)
properties.crystallographic_alignment: Massive dextral transcurrent strike-slip fault system in Alaska/Yukon with conjugate dilatational shears.
properties.geological_setting: Cretaceous reduced intrusion-related gold system (RIRGS); sheeted quartz vein networks.

properties.crystallographic_alignment: Layered mafic-ultramafic cumulate horizons where dense immiscible sulfide droplets settled into horizontal planar sheets along gravitational vector g.
properties.geological_setting: 2.7 Ga Archean layered intrusion; olivine-plagioclase cumulate stratigraphy with 10:1 Pd-to-Pt ratio.
properties.estimated_endowment: Highest grade platinum group metal deposit in the world (>30 million oz Pt+Pd reserves/resources)

properties.structural_trend: Lewis and Clark Line / Osburn Fault Zone (WNW strike ~285°)
properties.crystallographic_alignment: Forms an orthogonal 90° T-junction with the Idaho Batholith structural front, funneling regional hydrothermal fluid escape.
properties.geological_setting: Proterozoic Belt Supergroup siliciclastic metasedimentary rocks; deep polymetallic siderite-tetrahedrite-galena veins.
properties.estimated_endowment: >1.25 billion oz Ag mined (Greatest historic silver district in US history)

properties.structural_trend: Walker Lane Dextral Shear Zone (NW strike ~315°)
properties.crystallographic_alignment: 45° conjugate shear relative to the Basin and Range E-W extension direction.
properties.geological_setting: Miocene volcanic epithermal quartz-adularia fissure vein system on the footwall of Mount Davidson.
properties.estimated_endowment: >200 million oz Ag and 8 million oz Au

properties.structural_trend: Uinta-Tooele Structural Lineament / Oquirrh Range (E-W lineament intersecting N-S Wasatch fault)
properties.crystallographic_alignment: Direct 90° orthogonal structural intersection between the East-West Uinta Trend and the North-South Cordilleran fold-and-thrust belt.
properties.geological_setting: Eocene monzonite porphyry stock intruding Pennsylvanian quartzites and limestones; classic hydrothermal concentric zoning.
properties.estimated_endowment: >19 million metric tons of copper produced (>40 billion lbs Cu + significant Au, Ag, Mo)

properties.structural_trend: Jemez Lineament / Southwest Porphyry Copper Province (NE-SW strike ~045°)
properties.crystallographic_alignment: Aligns with the 45° Proterozoic basement boundary (Yavapai-Mazatzal crustal transition).
properties.geological_setting: Laramide calc-alkaline porphyry copper deposits with deep supergene enrichment blankets and deep skarns.
properties.estimated_endowment: Combined >50 million metric tons Cu (Resolution is one of the largest undeveloped copper deposits on Earth)

properties.structural_trend: McDermitt Volcanic Caldera Ring Complex (Circular ring-fault geometry)
properties.crystallographic_alignment: Radial and concentric ring-fault fractures associated with the inception of the Yellowstone mantle plume track (~16.5 Ma).
properties.geological_setting: Illite-smectite claystone lacustrine sediment formed in caldera lake following supervolcano collapse.
properties.estimated_endowment: Largest known lithium deposit in the United States and potentially the world (~20-40 million metric tons LCE)

properties.structural_trend: Inner Piedmont / Kings Mountain Shear Zone (NE strike ~045°)
properties.crystallographic_alignment: Conjugate ductile shear corridor in the Appalachian crystalline core.
properties.geological_setting: Late Paleozoic LCT (Lithium-Cesium-Tantalum) pegmatite dikes intruding amphibolites.
properties.estimated_endowment: Premier historic hard-rock spodumene lithium resource in eastern North America

properties.element: Rare Earth Elements (Nd, Pr, Dy, Tb)
properties.structural_trend: Mojave Desert Crustal Block / Ivanpah Fault (NW strike ~320°)
properties.crystallographic_alignment: Localized along an ancient 1.4 Ga Proterozoic intracontinental shear zone near the craton margin.
properties.geological_setting: Carbonatite intrusive stock with bastnäsite mineralization, depleted in radioactive thorium/uranium, rich in light REEs.
properties.estimated_endowment: The only operational integrated rare earth mining and processing facility in the United States (~1.5 million tons REO)

properties.name: Carlin Trend Shear Corridor
properties.description: Strikes 330° (NNW) across Nevada. Hosts over 90 million oz Au. Forms a 70.0° conjugate intersection with the Battle Mountain Trend.

properties.name: Battle Mountain - Eureka (Cortez) Trend
properties.description: Strikes 040° (NE). Intersects Carlin Trend at 70.0°, matching Gold's atomic {111} dihedral angle of 70.53°.

properties.name: Colorado Mineral Belt (COMB)
properties.description: Strikes 045° (NE) across the Colorado Rockies (San Juan Mts -> Leadville -> Breckenridge -> Boulder). Forms a 90.0° orthogonal conjugate with Walker Lane.

properties.name: Walker Lane Dextral Shear Zone
properties.description: Strikes 315° (NW) along CA/NV border. Direct 90.0° orthogonal conjugate to the Colorado Mineral Belt (315° - 45° = 90°).

properties.name: Lewis and Clark Line (Osburn Fault)
properties.description: Strikes 285° (WNW) from western Montana through the Coeur d'Alene Silver Valley in Idaho. Giant trans-lithospheric tear fault.

properties.name: Appalachian / Carolina Slate Gold Belt
properties.description: Strikes 050° (NE) from Dahlonega, GA through Haile, SC into North Carolina, paralleling the continental margin.

properties.name: Tintina Gold Fault Zone (Alaska/Yukon)
properties.description: Strikes 300° (NW) across interior Alaska through the Fairbanks/Fort Knox district, accommodating over 400 km of dextral strike-slip displacement.
